title: Multilingual Brain Surgeon: Large Language Models Can be Compressed Leaving No Language Behind

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the degradation in perplexity and zero-shot task accuracy across 20 different languages (including both high-resource and low-resource languages) after applying model compression techniques. The study compares the performance disparity caused by using English-centric, monolingual calibration datasets versus a proposed multilingual proportional sampling method.
